subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the paid-subscription program for {Brand}, after the renewal-weighting and benchmark points in my earlier emails. If onboarding-to-renewal quality and incrementality are on your roadmap this cycle, I can share the trial-to-paid and annual-plan view against the market bands this week, plus a short holdout read. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way, you have the context for when it becomes useful.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN health_and_fitness: references prior email and earlier stages; direct close with easy out (release if timing wrong); no figure; 0 question marks; native English; no sign-off; no X-not-Y negation.
